findings.evidence: run-local-manager.sh refuses NEANTIK_WEBKIT_HOST_ENABLED=1 and signs its disposable Dev app ad hoc; --fixture does embed NeAntikDevelopmentFixtureRoot but cannot produce the required Developer ID owned-WebKit ZIP
package-owned-webkit-release.py requires production bundle app.neantik.desktop and pinned candidate139 WebKit image hashes; it does not accept a Dev bundle
package-webkit-host.py supports --development-qa for app.neantik.desktop.dev and separately signed owned runtime, but expects a signed manager, host binary and staged Frameworks supplied by caller
direct_backup_signing.py sign requires production bundle ID; a Dev producer needs an explicit, scoped Developer ID signing path with Dev entitlements and no backup capability

verify_owned_webkit_qa_archive.py verifies exact archive SHA, embedded fixture root, manager/host bytes and owned image presence; launch-owned-webkit-qa.swift --check-only additionally requires owner-only stage/root, matching extracted manager and profile seed

nextImplementation: Build a disposable Dev producer that embeds the fixture root before Developer ID signing, assembles the Dev host/runtime with --development-qa from reviewed inputs, signs the outer Dev app, writes an exact ZIP and stage/seed receipts, then passes the existing ZIP verifier and one-use launcher check-only. Do not reuse retired candidate139 or its accepted ZIP.
